output_list.criticism: The vulnerability in the 'mintToken' function is linked to the lack of validation on 'mintedAmount' to ensure it does not cause an integer overflow when added to the balance. Additionally, the use of 'onlyOwner' does not inherently fix the overflow issue; it only restricts who can exploit it. The real issue here is the lack of validation on 'mintedAmount' to ensure it does not cause an overflow when added to the balance.
